name: France
summary: EU citizens need no permit. Non-EU nationals have a talent passport for economic investors (at least EUR 300,000 in fixed assets and 30% of the capital of a company, creating or keeping jobs), a long-stay 'visiteur' permit for people living on their own means without working, and the usual employer-sponsored permits. There is no digital nomad visa and no citizenship by investment.
naturalisation: Five years of regular residence (two with a French higher-education degree or services to France); French at B2 and a civic knowledge test since 1 January 2026; discretionary decision by the Ministry of the Interior.
dual_citizenship_note: France does not require renunciation (general knowledge; the service-public pages retrieved did not state it).

routes.name: EU/EEA/Swiss free movement
routes.summary: EU citizens need no permit and no registration.
routes.requirements: Directive 2004/38/EC; non-workers need sufficient means and health insurance. Permanent residence after 5 years.

routes.name: Talent passport: economic investor (L.313-20-7 CESEDA, former numbering)
routes.summary: Multi-year residence card for investing at least EUR 300,000 in a French company and holding at least 30% of its capital.
routes.requirements: Investment of at least EUR 300,000 in tangible or intangible fixed assets in France, directly or through a company; the applicant manages the company or holds at least 30% of its capital; plan to create or keep jobs within four years; no threat to public order. Permit up to four years, renewable (secondary source). Fee EUR 350 reported from 1 May 2026 (unverified).
routes.physical_presence: Reside in France; absences over 6 months in a year can affect renewal (not sourced)
routes.family: Spouse and minor children receive a family permit tied to the principal's duration (secondary source).
routes.tax_note: Becoming a French tax resident follows Article 4 B CGI, not the permit.

routes.name: Long-stay visa / residence card 'visiteur'
routes.summary: One-year renewable permit for people who live in France on their own resources without working.
routes.requirements: Sufficient stable resources and health insurance; no professional activity. The exact resource level (the SMIC-linked figure) was not retrieved.
routes.physical_presence: Live in France; absences limited (not sourced)
